public_rationale: The claim is that benchmark success is only a limited indicator of general intelligence. The contract looks at research from 2024-01-01 to the post date of 2026-02-17. Two studies in that period fit its support condition. The GSM-Symbolic study (Mirzadeh et al., first posted 2024-10-07, listed as ICLR 2025) reports that the performance of all models it tested declined when only the numbers in GSM8K-style questions were changed. It also reports drops of up to 65% when one clause was added that seemed relevant but did not affect the answer. 'The Leaderboard Illusion' (Singh et al., preprint, 2025-04-29) estimates, conservatively, that even limited extra Chatbot Arena data can give relative gains of up to 112% on the arena distribution. The authors state that the dynamics they describe result in 'overfitting to Arena-specific dynamics rather than general model quality'. The packet contains no evidence that benchmark success reliably tracks robust general capability.
limitations: 'General intelligence' has no agreed measure, and neither study measures it directly. The studies show benchmark scores overstating robustness, or being shaped by effects specific to one benchmark.
The evidence covers two settings, GSM8K-style maths questions and the Chatbot Arena leaderboard. It does not cover benchmarks in general.

The Leaderboard Illusion is a preprint. Its 112% figure is the authors' own estimate of gains on the arena distribution. The overfitting statement is their interpretation and is not a separate measurement of general quality.
'Limited indicator' has no threshold, so the claim is partly conceptual.

our_interpretation: Plain reading: published evidence shows that high scores on AI benchmarks often do not carry over to robust performance when tasks change modestly, or reflect overfitting to the benchmark rather than general quality. So benchmark scores alone are a weak guide to general intelligence.

criteria.support_condition: Credible studies before the post show benchmark scores overstating general ability, for example performance drops under small perturbations, or leaderboard rankings reflecting overfitting rather than general quality.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Credible evidence that benchmark success reliably tracks robust general capability under novel conditions, with little gap between benchmark and perturbed or real-world performance.
